facts.title: Untitled UI — Figma UI Kit and React Component Library
facts.description: Untitled UI is the world's largest Figma UI kit and React component library. Kickstart any project with everything you need to design and develop—fast.

research.name: Untitled UI
research.note: Large Figma UI kit with a matching React component library built on Tailwind CSS and React Aria.
unverified: The React components are in the public repository untitleduico/react (MIT, about 2,000 stars, last commit 2026-10-09); that repository has not been researched yet, and the full Figma kit and PRO components are paid.
